description: pitwall (T3a): a session brief, guards on secrets, main, merge protection, ai-review and their own switch, call budgets, and the gate after edits and before stopping; in pitwall projects only. Each hook first checks for .claude/pitwall.json and for node, so a machine without node blocks no other project.

hooks.command: [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/pitwall.json" ] || exit 0; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"pitwall: Node.js is not on PATH, so its guards refuse every tool call. Install the Node LTS from https://nodejs.org, or turn pitwall off in this project: run this yourself in a terminal, not through an agent: claude plugin disable pitwall@pitwall --scope local"}'; exit 0; }; exec node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.mjs" session-start

[ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/pitwall.json" ] || exit 0; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"pitwall refused this call (broken): Node.js is not on PATH, so its guard cannot run. Install the Node LTS from https://nodejs.org. To turn pitwall off in this project, run this yourself in a terminal, not through an agent (the guard stops an agent that tries): claude plugin disable pitwall@pitwall --scope local."}}'; exit 0; }; exec node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.mjs" pre-tool-use
[ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/pitwall.json" ] || exit 0; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.mjs" post-tool-use
[ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/pitwall.json" ] || exit 0; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.mjs" stop
[ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/pitwall.json" ] || exit 0; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.mjs" subagent-stop
